# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.31.0 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.31.0
**Date:** 2026-07-27
**Previous release:** v0.30.0
Version 0.31.0 makes the world physical. One deterministic character-physics engine now runs in
the offline sim, on the authoritative server, and in the client's self-extrapolator, so every model
you can see collides exactly as it is drawn, and a real traversal ladder sits on top of it: stride
over the low things, vault the waist-high things, and pull yourself up onto the things above your
head. Alongside it the release hardens the corpse-harvest pipeline against every malformed request
